integrity: Exact counts follow from a Jordan-block classification, centralizer unit orbit sizes, and a proved product limit; finite exhaustive checks complement but do not replace infinite proofs. No external independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The quadratic fiber belongs to the two-length nilpotent module family only; asymptotic laws hold for fixed finite-field order, and the first defect has a parity-dependent limit. Nilpotent-root Jordan existence theory, centralizer units and orbit-stabilizer are prior tools. An unidentified broader enumeration theorem could subsume aspects of the result.
title: Square-root fibers and independent defects in finite nilpotent endomorphism rings
